note: Hazen Parks & Recreation's newest RV park, on 10th St NE on the north side of town north of Hwy 200; three rows of gravel pull-through sites on open ground beside a comfort station. --Claude
summary: Hazen Parks page + WebReserv page + park map: 45 pull-through year-round sites with water, sewer and 50 A, comfort station (7 bathrooms with showers, laundry), wifi; online booking off line, reserve by phone. No rate posted anywhere official. Hookups/sites/facilities/season/booking written. Pin ~2 km off (moved to the loops). Not waterfront stands.
flags: PIN: stored 47.29400,-101.64350 is ~2.0 km WSW of the park, on a tree-planted angled parking area by a playground in town. The RV park (three rows of 15 angled pull-throughs, comfort station on 10th St NE, matching the city's map) is at ~47.30394,-101.62057 (Google 47.30352,-101.62042 is the comfort station). Move the pin to 47.30394,-101.62057.

FEES: no Antelope Creek rate on any official page (the WebReserv price list carries only Lewis & Clark's short-term sites, $25 a night / $150 a week). The only dated figure is a Campendium camper report, $20 a night (2020-05-26), too old to use. Nothing written.

PHONE: stored (701) 748-2267 = '748-CAMP' on the city's park map and on Google; keep. The park page gives the Hazen Parks office 701-748-6948 and the WebReserv page says to call 701-880-8212 for Antelope Creek reservations while online booking is off line - the reviewer may prefer 701-880-8212 as the reservation number.

LONG-STAY / WORKFORCE: the operator calls them '45 year-round sites'; no monthly or seasonal rate is posted and no wording discourages nightly guests ('We do have sites available'). Imagery shows only ~4 RVs in 45 sites, so not a filled workforce camp. HHS registry: 'ANTELOPE CREEK R.V. PARK, 220 10 Street NE, Hazen, HAZEN PARK BOARD, 45'. Google 4.2 from 25. Nightly share not measurable from the pages; no flag beyond this.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands; Antelope Creek (the stream) meanders 100-200 m south of the sites, across 10th St and a field.
WEBSITE: stored hazenparks.com page is the operator's and works; keep.
